mentions.name: Epoptes
mentions.description: This open-source tool runs coding agents (Claude, Codex, Pi, Antigravity) autonomously for long periods while letting the user monitor and steer their work. Runs lasting over 20 hours have been used for game development, research, and building other tools.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to get back into making games, a hobby hard to find time for, by giving agents a goal, letting them work for hours, and returning to something to try and give feedback on.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Epoptes, an open-source tool that lets me run coding agents (Claude, Codex, Pi, Antigravity) autonomously for long periods while still being able to monitor and steer their work.
